objective: Recognise equivalent ratios and their common multiplicative scale factor, and scale both parts of a two-term ratio consistently to find a missing value.
scopeNote: One narrow, original task family for Year 8 Ratio & Proportion (Calculate layer only, Rungs 1-3) — not the entire Year 8 ratio curriculum. See docs/learning_architecture/YEAR8_RATIO_AND_KS4_QUADRATICS_BLUEPRINTS_V1.md for the full planned blueprint this is one slice of.

rungs.name: Recognise
rungs.description: Identify whether two ratios are equivalent, and identify the common multiplicative scale factor between equivalent ratios. Clean small positive integers only, no ambiguous phrasing.

rungs.name: Guided practice
rungs.description: Solve a one-step missing-value ratio scaling task. A concise, original worked hint is available after an incorrect answer or on explicit request, explaining that both linked quantities must use the same scale factor.

rungs.name: Fluency variation
rungs.description: Solve independent one-step ratio scaling tasks, varying the numbers, the phrasing, and the direction of scaling (multiplying up or dividing down). No hint is shown automatically. No multi-step ratio, algebra, percentage, fractions, worded exam contexts, or visual/lab interaction.

diagnosticSignatures.description: The learner's selected answer equals the unscaled original value of the term they were asked to find — consistent with scaling one side of the ratio and leaving the other unchanged, rather than applying the same scale factor to both. Authored for this exact task family; never inferred from a numeric coincidence.

generation.note: Every item is constructed backward from its intended whole-number answer, then re-validated before display. See lib/services/ratio_foundations_task_generator.dart.
